newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo in $200 mln China building project.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo in $200 mln China building project.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp said on Friday it had signed a $200 million contract with its real estate development subsidiary in China to build and sell apartments and annexed facilities in Shanghai, China.
A Daewoo Corp statement said the project was being promoted by its subsidiary, Shanghai Daewoo Real Estate Development Co, which was established last year.
Daewoo will build and sell 12 apartment buildings of 22 to 26 floors, and other facilities such as stores, health-care centres, kindergartens and parking facilities.
Construction is due to begin in March 1998 for completion by March 2001, it said.
Daewoo Corp is a foreign trading and construction unit of the Daewoo Group DWGR.CN.
